content.title: Boston Marathon Qualifying Times & Standards (1970–2027)
content.text: Looking for Boston Marathon qualifying times? Boston Marathon qualifying times are age and category-based marathon standards set by the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.) for the right to register for Boston aech year. In high-demand years runners must beat those times by an additional cutoff to be accepted. This page provides a complete historical reference of Boston Marathon qualifying times from 1970 through 2027, including: Official BQ standards by age and gender Acceptance and rejection statistics Time-under-standard cutoff requirements Special qualification rules (including downhill indexing penalties) Use the year selector below to view BQ standards by age group and category from 1970–2027, plus cutoffs (time under standard) when applicable. Qualification Standards for the 2027 Boston Marathon 2027 Boston Marathon Downhill Indexing Penalty Add 5 minutes to finish times for races with a net-elevation loss between 1,500 feet (457.2 meters) and 2,999 feet (914.1 meters). Add 10 minutes to finish times for races with a net-elevation loss between 3,000 feet (914.2 meters) and 5,999 feet (1,828.5 meters). Any course with a net-downhill of 6,000 feet (1,828.6 meters) or greater will no longer be allowed for Boston Marathon qualifying purposes.
